verdict.rationale: Floot is an AI app builder, so plugging external MCP servers into its assistant is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows Floot acting as an MCP server that clients like Claude, Cursor and VS Code connect to. Nothing shows Floot itself connecting to or using tools from third-party MCP servers. Server-side MCP evidence belongs to a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
